entities.name: Alexandre Jacques François Bertrand
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandre Jacques François Bertrand was a French medical doctor and mesmerist who was a native of Rennes. He was the father of archaeologist Alexandre Bertrand (1820–1902) and mathematician Joseph Bertrand (1822–1900). He was also an ally of philosopher Pierre Leroux (1798–1871) and the Saint-Simonians.
